tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ Implement and test DF-OFF-BY-ONE-38: queue estimated_time must not promise a materially stale historical average; either use recent/language-appropriate observed solve durations or expose a truthful progress/heartbeat signal, with tests and updated API documentation; go build/vet/test and gitreins guard pass.: Implementation (commit a5926274): internal/ingest/queue.go:573 adds `const avgSolveTimeWindow = 20`; AvgSolveTime (queue.go:582-601) now averages completed_at-started_at over a bounded subquery `ORDER BY completed_at DESC, id ASC LIMIT ?` instead of all-history, so months-old fast solves can no longer underquote current waits. All four callers route through it — handlers.go:341 (submit ETA), :670 (queue list), :696 (queue detail), :742 (stats avg_solve_time) — and no all-history path remains (grep of non-test AvgSolveTime callers confirms). Empty-window fallback preserved: returns 0 via sql.NullFloat64, handlers fall back to defaultPerJobEstimate=30s (handlers.go:1164). TESTS: internal/ingest/queue_test.go:1079 TestQueue_AvgSolveTime_RecentWindow, :1113 TestQueue_AvgSolveTime_WindowDropsOldest, :1137 TestQueue_AvgSolveTime_NoCompletes; internal/api/handlers_test.go:3163 TestSubmit_EstimatedTimeUsesRecentWindow (asserts raw-JSON estimated_time key, pending/in_progress/terminal semantics, and stats avg_solve_time). RED proof: reverting queue.go to the pre-fix all-history query produced `--- FAIL: TestQueue_AvgSolveTime_RecentWindow ... AvgSolveTime = 1m26.956522387s, want 1m34s`, `--- FAIL: TestQueue_AvgSolveTime_WindowDropsOldest ... got 57.142857568s, want 10s`, `--- FAIL: TestSubmit_EstimatedTimeUsesRecentWindow ... fixture window mean = 1m26.956522387s, want 1m34s`; file restored, git diff clean. GREEN: `go test ./internal/ingest/... ./internal/api/... -count=1 -run 'AvgSolveTime|EstimatedTime|Submit' -v` -> all PASS, `ok internal/ingest 0.040s`, `ok internal/api 0.046s`. DOCS: docs/api-reference.md:411 documents the rolling 20-solve window honestly (and :245 stats note), docs/integration.md:245 updated, pkg/api/openapi.yaml:514-515/693-694/825-826 describe the rolling window for estimated_time and avg_solve_time. GATES: `go build ./...` exit 0; `go vet ./...` exit 0; `gofmt -l cmd/ internal/ pkg/ sql/` empty (exit 0); `go test ./... -short -p 1 -count=1 -timeout 300s` -> every package ok (api, ingest, cron, export, graph, import, metrics, muster, sandbox, seed, solver, tools, web, pkg/api); `gitreins guard --full` with Go files staged -> `Tier 1 Guards: PASS (test mode: full, whole tree)` with secrets clean, go_build ok, go_tests passed, exit 0. LSP diagnostics: 0 findings.
DF-OFF-BY-ONE-38 is fully implemented: queue ETA now derives from a rolling 20-solve window (RED-proven tests, updated docs/openapi), and go build/vet/test plus gitreins guard all pass.
